mapper.update: UPDATE bookmark_ai_classification_task SET status = 'PAUSED', paused_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE bookmark_ai_classification_task SET status = 'RUNNING', resumed_at = NOW(), recovery_count = recovery_count + CASE WHEN status = 'RECOVERABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PAUSED', 'RECOVERABLE')
UPDATE bookmark_ai_classification_task SET status = 'RUNNING', phase = 'SMALL_CLUSTER_DRAFTS', completed_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
UPDATE bookmark_ai_classification_task SET status = 'RECOVERABLE', error_message = COALESCE(error_message, '服务重启前任务未完成') WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE bookmark_ai_classification_task SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW()), error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE bookmark_ai_classification_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', phase = 'APPLYING', completed_at = NOW(), error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM bookmark_ai_classification_task WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED', 'RECOVERABLE') )
